title: Imperative statement syntax
statement: An imperative statement is built from a no-operation statement, assignment of an arithmetic expression to a natural-number variable, storage of one expression at the address given by another, sequential composition, a conditional with two branches, a while loop, or a procedure call with a natural-number identifier, a list of expression arguments, and a natural-number destination variable. Expressions are formed from natural-number constants and variable indices, binary addition, subtraction, or multiplication, and memory loads; conditions compare two expressions using either strict inequality or equality.
